parameters.name: EnsRegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the Edge Node Service (ENS) node.

parameters.name: EnsRegionIds
parameters.description: The IDs of edge nodes. You can specify 1 to 100 IDs.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the NAT gateway.

parameters.name: NatGatewayId
parameters.description: The ID of the NAT gateway.

parameters.name: NatGatewayIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the NAT gateways. You can specify 1 to 100 IDs.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number. Pages start from page **1**.

Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page. The maximum value is **100**.

Default value: **10**.
